description: Held-out question set for the Ask Dad RAG faithfulness eval (plan 0007). 'answerable' questions are grounded in topics Dr. Calhoun actually wrote about (the Forbes corpus: COVID & finance, the Fed, inflation, Europe's fiscal union, Huawei, semiconductors, Hong Kong, China-listed shares). 'unanswerable' questions are deliberately outside the archive so the eval can check that Ask Dad abstains ('I haven't written about that specifically') instead of inventing. topic_hint is a human note for spot-checking retrieval, not used by the scorers.
